column1: # meta-reviewer patch-effects audit trail — append-only, in-repo, durable
# One tab-separated line per evaluated patch. Format:
# Only "no_effect" verdicts land here. Other verdicts (effective,
# inconclusive, too_early, aged_out, user_reverted) live in the
# Why this file exists: durable cross-machine record of patches that
# did not reduce their target signal's rate. Greppable from
# `git revert <patch_sha>` to remove a flagged patch.
# DO NOT EDIT existing lines. The meta-reviewer appends only (`>>`).
# Header lines (this block) survive forever; data lines below.
